data.description: Visitor-facing accent randomizer for demo pages. Renders a floating button that lets unauthenticated visitors roll a new accent color for the demo subtree. State persists per-session in sessionStorage and is scoped to the configured path prefix so the rolled color follows the visitor across sub-pages of the same demo.

scopePrefix.description: Path prefix where the button activates. Match is exact (no trailing slash) OR any sub-path of `<prefix>/`. Example: `/demo/flinthills/` shows the button on `/demo/flinthills/`, `/demo/flinthills/services/`, etc., but not on `/services/`.

label.description: Button label. Defaults to `Try a new color`.

hint.description: Optional sublabel rendered under the main label. Defaults to `Demo only — your visit only`.
